9namespace dyf::RHI
10{
11    enum class ShaderStage : uint8_t
12    {
13        Unknown,
14        Vertex,
15        Fragment,
16        Compute
17    };
18
19    struct ShaderDesc
20    {
21        ShaderStage stage = ShaderStage::Unknown;
22        const char* entryPoint = nullptr;
23        const void* binary = nullptr;
24        std::size_t binarySize = 0;
25    };
26
27    class Shader
28    {
29    public:
30        [[nodiscard]] ShaderStage GetStage() const { return m_stage; }
31        [[nodiscard]] const char* GetEntryPoint() const { return m_entryPoint.c_str(); }
32        [[nodiscard]] const void* GetBinary() const { return m_binary.data(); }
33        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t GetBinarySize() const { return m_binary.size(); }
34
35    protected:
36        virtual ~Shader() = default;
37        explicit Shader(const ShaderDesc& desc)
38            : m_stage(desc.stage)
39            , m_entryPoint(desc.entryPoint == nullptr ? "" : desc.entryPoint)
40            , m_binary(desc.binarySize)
41        {
42            if(desc.binary != nullptr && desc.binarySize != 0)
43            {
44                std::memcpy(m_binary.data(), desc.binary, desc.binarySize);
45            }
46        }
47
48    private:
49        ShaderStage m_stage = ShaderStage::Unknown;
50        std::string m_entryPoint;
51        std::vector<uint8_t> m_binary;
52    };
53}
